newsitem.title: BELARUS: Belarus grain harvest yield up at 2.5 T/ha vs 2.2.
newsitem.headline: Belarus grain harvest yield up at 2.5 T/ha vs 2.2.

text.p: Belarus grain yields, with 95 percent of the sown land harvested, stand at 2.5 tonnes per hectare, up from 2.2 tonnes per hectare at this time a year ago, an agriculture ministry official said on Thursday.
Grain department chief Vladimir Kuratnik told Reuters Belarus had cut 2.28 million hectares of grain and threshed the crop from 2.25 million hectares.
Belarus had also harvested 95 percent of the sown area at this time in 1995.
Last year Belarus harvested 5.5 million tonnes, down from 5.9 million tonnes in 1994.
